name: Do I need a permit to replace my front door in Huntington Beach?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to replace my front door in Huntington Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Huntington Beach, a permit is typically required for front door replacement if the opening size is being altered or if the door is part of a structural change. However, if you are replacing an existing door with one of the same size and type, a permit may not be necessary. It's always best to consult with your contractor or the local building department to confirm specific requirements for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A permit is usually needed in Huntington Beach if the door opening is altered. Confirm with your contractor or the local building department.
